text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're carrying all that to the
science lab? By yourself? Here,
let me
help out!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for always cleaning up! I'm going to
go throw out this trash!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whew! That was some good training! Not
only did it feel great, but it
was fun to
boot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As always, Kita can't turn a blind eye to
those in need. Meanwhile,
her training is
going as smooth as butter.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that reminds me! I wanted to ask you
something, Trainer... When I
make my
break for the finish line, um...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see! In the end, it all comes down to
posture. If I can keep my legs
and upper
body in line with each other while lowering
my center of
gravity... Mm-hm.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Um, do you mind if I run for a little while
longer? I want to try out
some of the
things you just taught me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, thank you! All righty! Time to
shave some time off!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kita begins running again, and I can't help
but be fascinated by her
charming, yet
fierce, side profile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kita is always looking forward and
searching for ways to better
herself. Her
presence alone raises the morale of those
around her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I rub my eyes and force myself
wide-awake. I want to help Kita—not

because of my job as her trainer—but
because I truly believe in her
potential.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Get this, Dad—my trainer is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The training we do is really tough, but I
can feel myself improving
every single day!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whenever there's something on my mind,
they always come up with
great tips and
fresh ideas for my training!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, that's right. I can fret about a
problem forever and ever without
finding a
solution, but Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Agh, it's no use! The more I try to not think about them, the more I end up thinking about the people behind me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's just, when I try to focus only on what's
in front of me, I get all
antsy...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Well, um... Like, what if they're about to
overtake me? Or what if
there's someone
who's come up right behind me?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
And when that happens, I can't let them
pass me, now can I? But when
I think
about this stuff too much, it starts to affect
my running...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
What defines my running? Front running,
of course. I run, run some
more, and fly to
the front of the whole pack.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: From start to finish, I keep up my pace so that even if someone were to try and catch up, I'd simply be too fast and too far in the front.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Basically, I keep my distance from the
main pack and cross the finish
line first.
That's how I run!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer always listens to me and helps me
out. But that's not all,
either.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I'm dealing with a problem that
needs a solution, they'll
give me a bunch
of advice so I can find the answer for
myself.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
One day, I want to be just as cool. I want
to be able to respond to
people's
problems without a second thought—just
like that.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Th-that's true...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Right. That's right... It was so obvious this
whole time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black realizes something from her
father's words, tightly
clenching her fists
with newfound resolve.
